title: StatsTable
description: Tidy pipeline-stats rows produced by tcc.stats (Phase 2), parsed from fossilize-replay --enable-pipeline-stats CSV output. Parser is name-substring-tolerant; unmatched stat fields are kept under `extra` (JSON-encoded). Field names below were fixed against a real vkd3d-proton (Remnant II) run on RX 7800 XT / RADV; `spilled_vgprs` (not `spills`) matches mine.py's offender-score formula.
